description:
Release date: May 17, 2019

Famed poet/songwriter/singer and visual artist, Ingrid Chavez, is taking flight anew on her new album.

'Memories Of Flying' is Chavez's most ambitious project to date and finds the artist reaching across the globe for new and innovative collaborators. In that search, she found a musical home with some of the world's most talented and creative musicians. Now working with legendary house music producer Charles Webster (UK), Ganga (Denmark), Mashti (Denmark), Deep Dive Corp. (Germany), Marco Valentin (Chicago), David Hurn (UK), and Hush Forever (Sweden), Ingrid explores new genres of lush electronic landscapes and pushes her boundaries to continue her journey as an artist, all while staying true to her unique storytelling in poetry and song.
